summary:
Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repository, but no tests were run because you asked me not to run repository code.

Changes:
- rich/progress.py: new TimeElapsedColumn between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn; Task.finished_time field (before visible); Task.finished is now "finished_time is not None"; _reset clears finished_time; Progress.update, advance (inside the lock, after sample append) capture elapsed when completed >= total; Progress.reset clears it explicitly.
- rich/default_styles.py: progress.elapsed styled yellow.
- rich/palette.py: Palette.__rich__ with in-method imports and TYPE_CHECKING-only Table import; headers "index", "RGB", "Color"; caption "N colors" right-justified; highlight on.
- CHANGELOG.md: Unreleased section with Added entries for TimeElapsedColumn and Palette.__rich__.
- tests/test_palette.py: test_rich_cast (16 rows).
- tests/test_progress.py: test_time_elapsed_column (unstarted, running, finished-and-frozen, driven by public calls); test_columns updated with the new column and an expected string derived by hand-tracing clock reads.

Verification status: nothing was executed. The test_columns expected output is a hand trace: unfinished bars 33 -> 25, finished bars 23 -> 16 (speed column also narrows to 8 since both speeds are "1 byte/s"), elapsed values 0:00:37 / 0:00:36 at start, 0:01:00 / 0:00:45 frozen at finish. Running the suite is needed to confirm it. No commit was made.
